system.description: This wand is fashioned from a skeletal legbone, possibly human, with a crude iron sigil of the Chaos Star lashed to its tip. Sprouting from the lashwork around the sigil are a collection of bright and exotic feathers in the colours of every rainbow. They don’t appear to be from any birds you're familiar with, however... Encumbrance: 2 As a manoeuvre, you may draw up to 3 power from the wand of feathers, as long as it is in your hand (or other similar appendage). For each power you draw from the wand, roll a challenge die {Dc}. For each Chaos Star result, suffer 1
